summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for MISE webcam studio on http://127.0.0.1:3000. Core flows are functional: app load, camera ready, captures, labels save/persist, session start/stop, and API image/metadata contracts.

minor.issue: Automated pytest run fails when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported in shell; suite requires explicit env export at execution time.

integration_issues.flow: Auto Detect initialization in headless/browser environments without WebGL
integration_issues.issue: Console shows TensorFlow WebGL backend initialization warnings after Auto Detect is clicked (not before click). Detection still completes and model status becomes READY.

action_items: Optional hardening: suppress or gracefully downgrade expected TFJS WebGL warnings in non-GPU/headless contexts.
Align environment/documentation with current structure: app uses /app/.env (no /app/frontend/.env present).
Quote env values containing spaces (e.g., VITE_CAMERA_LABEL) if shell sourcing is expected in scripts.
critical_code_review_comments: runtimeConfig.ts uses Vite env keys only (VITE_API_BASE_URL, etc.); project-level guideline referencing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL appears outdated for this Vite app and should be unified.
Current /app/.env includes an unquoted spaced value (VITE_CAMERA_LABEL) which breaks plain shell 'source' workflows used by test runners/ops scripts.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test captures via POST /api/captures and one manual zone label via UI during regression run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified single active frontend process under supervisor on port 3000. /tmp/mise-capture-store.json is capped at 20 captures (~1.1MB in this run). No crash/oom/quota exceptions reproduced.
rca of the issue: No blocking crash reproduced. Previous 'nothing functional' symptom is not reproducible now. Remaining warnings are environment/runtime noise (missing WebGL backend in headless context, legacy frontend.err historical entries). Core camera capture-label-save-reload pipeline is stable in this build.
mocked_api: NO MOCKED APIs detected or used in this test run.
